description: Statements as filed, one document per filing and statement, newest filing first. Free with no sign-in: AAPL, MSFT, JPM, KO, XOM, NVDA, AMZN, GOOGL, TSLA, LLY. Costs 3 credits. One page only: pass `limit` (1–20, default 4) and `cursor` from `meta.next_cursor`. A typical page of 4 documents is about 45 KB (median in the pilot sample); large pages stay under the API document budget (~4 MB). A figure can be withheld (null/absent beats a guess). A figure can change or disappear when a later filing arrives; figures are not versioned. Read `adjustments` for extractor decisions beyond copying one filed figure. This is filing data, not investment advice.

cursor.description: The meta.next_cursor of the previous page.
